title: Virtual Open Tennis
overview:
Whether you're a tennis fan or not, you'll love Virtual Open Tennis! Because on clay, grass, or hard court, Virtual Open Tennis has all the power, speed, realism and excitement a sports fan could ask for!

Players:
- Select from 10 unique players
- In-depth stats including points won, serve percent, maximum speed, service aces, slices as percent of all shots
- 3 modes of play

Courts:
- 3 court surfaces
- Choose 1 of 8 camera views
- Detailed tennis environment
- Realistic tennis sounds

Realism:
- 2 simulated tournaments
- Instant replay
- 1 to 5 set matches
- Doubles or singles match-ups
